status: acceptance-plan; use run summary for execution results
oracle: Actual extracted production functions and actual transaction/session headers; no copied request/advance/store implementation.

cases.name: request-missing-sample
cases.expectation: No lease: request returns ok=false, creates no pending owner, no native or persistence effect.

cases.name: request-stale-sample
cases.expectation: Expire queue timestamp or retire power/raw/capture: request refuses before admission.

cases.name: request-busy-preserves-first-key
cases.expectation: Second request while pending/active returns busy and cannot replace the first exact Key or reset its window.

cases.name: request-exact-model-scope
cases.expectation: Only the four exact routes are admitted; no Windows calibration marker changes on any route.

cases.name: request-before-first-handle
cases.expectation: Request binds a current Sample Key; later actual Session preparation may consume only that exact Key.

cases.name: pending-source-change
cases.expectation: Retire physical identity, sensor, power, raw generation and capture epoch separately; old pending cannot attach to new handle.

cases.name: active-source-change
cases.expectation: Same retirement matrix after preparation: cancel old transaction before owner destruction; no success/store.

cases.name: tablet-left-right-persistence
cases.expectation: Save distinct left/right candidates; reload by physicalIdentity+sensorIndex and retain both records.

cases.name: persistence-preserves-unrelated-records
cases.expectation: Keep all pre-existing Windows root calibration values, unrelated JSON fields, other physical identities and sides. Generations never enter persistence keys.

cases.name: persistence-atomic-failure
cases.expectation: Real isolated temp write; controlled file open/replace failure. Original data remains intact, no candidate application and no saved claim.

cases.name: successful-candidate-order
cases.expectation: Real prepare/process/observe/candidate path saves before apply. SetMode/SetOffset effects target only the bound controller handle.

cases.name: confidence-rejection-and-readback
cases.expectation: Follow real transaction acceptance policy: untrusted/nonfinite readback produces no saved result. Threshold values come from the actual header, not a fabricated gate.

cases.name: abort-revoke-stop-sleep
cases.expectation: Pending and active cancellations through actual Abort/SessionRevoke paths and controlled lifecycle retirement; no stale transaction survives. No real PBT.

cases.name: old-token-new-handle
cases.expectation: Retired old Key/transaction cannot run callbacks against the successor handle, even with same physical identity/side.

cases.name: ui-result-status-contract
cases.expectation: Every failure/cancellation result explicitly saved=false. Successful result offset/weight/confidence reflects persisted data. Status uses the existing four UI tokens.

cases.name: windows-state-isolation
cases.expectation: Every native callback rejects Windows sentinel. Snapshot independent Windows state before/after request/status/advance/abort/store; zero marker writes.

cases.name: pre-request-receipt-no-training
cases.expectation: A current pre-request sample may admit Request but cannot train; prepare still receives zero for time progression.

cases.name: request-replaced-ui-id-fence
cases.expectation: Expired same-key replacement cancels old transaction and logs old ID without completing/clearing the new UI request.

cases.name: log-exception-still-destroys-owner
cases.expectation: Controlled log sink exception during noexcept Abort cannot skip Session destroy or keep borrowed transaction state.

cases.name: missing-owner-cancels-pending
cases.expectation: Missing read/calibration callbacks, failed create and unavailable source before first owner complete pending requests without persistence.

cases.name: saved-trust-restored-new-epoch
cases.expectation: Stored offset and trusted status restore on a new Session/epoch in the same single JSON read; repeat ticks do not reread or republish.

cases.name: legacy-offset-not-trusted
cases.expectation: Legacy missing confidence and inconsistent weight/confidence still restore valid offset without claiming trust.

executionBoundary.executedAfterBinding: Actual request/status/store/advance/abort and selected lease/session/lifecycle methods with controlled boundaries.
executionBoundary.sourceOnly: Whole UI, IPC registration, onGamepad and OS shutdown/sleep callers unless individually extracted later.
executionBoundary.fileIO: Only fresh evidence-owned paths; actual product calibration path provider is not executed.
